id.title: Id
id.description: A short name, unique in this file.

title.title: Title
title.description: The programme or round, as the funder names it.

type.title: Kind
type.description: What sort of funding it is.
type.$comment: Instance-defined vocabulary: real instances use their own words. The examples are the framework's defaults.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: Where it runs: a grants platform, a foundation.

status.title: Status
status.$comment: Instance-defined vocabulary: real instances use their own words. The examples are the framework's defaults.

deadline.title: Deadline
deadline.description: A date (YYYY-MM-DD), or a word where there is none: rolling, TBD.

amount_available.title: Amount available
amount_available.description: How much the round holds, as a number.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The currency of the amount: USD, EUR, a token.

relevance.title: Relevance
relevance.description: How well it fits the work.

url.title: Link
url.description: Where to read about it and apply.

application_id.title: Application id
application_id.description: The funder's reference for the application.

$comment: Optional fields accept null: in these YAML registries an explicitly-unset field is written as `null`, and refusing it made real entries unsavable.
